cohort: The study was performed on 186 mothers who had recently given birth to a baby in southern Iran.
finding: The prevalence of PPD was 24.2% 3 days after delivery and 3.2% 6 months after delivery, with anxiety, prenatal care quality, educational level, and stress identified as predictors.
mod_finding: Type of delivery predicted 24% of the variance of PPD 6 months after delivery.
cross-section timing: 3 days after delivery and 6 months after childbirth
